error.message: The desktop portal ended the screenshot request without a result (response 2)
error.suggestion: The portal shows one screenshot dialog at a time, so a dialog left open by an earlier call is the usual cause: answer it or wait up to 25 seconds for the portal to close it, then retry. Other causes: a person chose Deny, or the portal backend failed (check that xdg-desktop-portal and its backend for this desktop run)
